items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1969-01-27
items.q: And me and that boy, we were just like two brothers, you know what I mean?

ctx.x: Well, just that he told me that you went out there and, uh, you laid the hole down and never came back. He left. Right, right. Didn't get you pay or anything. Never. But anyway, uh, I wanted to ask you about, uh, that clarinet player from out of the country that quit playing. You know the man I'm talking about? Oh yeah.

I was playing with that band. After all these boys left from there, I went to play with that band. You know what I mean? Oh yeah, you're talking about, uh, well he got a French name. Lili. That's his name. That's all I know his name, Lili. He was a good boy, you know that boy was a nice, class day. And after I was down, I got him to come play with, uh, yeah, when I first came down here, I played with Mud Carey's brother, you know, and, uh, I got him to come here to, uh, Jack Carey, you know, to play down here…
He wouldn't fool the clan anymore. Was he as good as Edmund Hall?
